clauses.name: Mazzolong, the Log-chief
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Mazzolong is in the Interzone, whenever you play a manifestation in Support, draw a card.

clauses.name: Keen-eyed Seeker
clauses.printedParagraph: When Keen-Eyed Seeker enters the field, draw a card.

clauses.name: Reliable Ammonite
clauses.printedParagraph: When Reliable Ammonite is used as tribute, draw a card.

clauses.name: Callus, the Thought-stirrer
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Callus is in the Interzone, whenever you play a Will, draw a card.

clauses.name: Hermetic Threshold
clauses.printedParagraph: Draw a card whenever a player plays their first Will during a turn.

clauses.name: Dark Apparition
clauses.printedParagraph: When the Dark Apparition enters the field, a target player discards a card from their hand.

clauses.name: Filth-eater
clauses.printedParagraph: If Filth-Eater is used as tribute, a target player discards a card from their hand.

clauses.name: Wheel of Retribution
clauses.printedParagraph: Whenever a manifestation enters Support, the player who controls that manifestation discards a card from their hand.

clauses.name: Makaboon
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Makaboon is on the field, whenever a player discards one or more cards from their deck, in addition that player discards a card from their hand.

clauses.name: Powerful Pidue
clauses.printedParagraph: If 🔮, a target player Discards 1 card from their hand.

clauses.name: Zum, the Manifold
clauses.printedParagraph: {P}: A target player discards 1 card from the top of the deck.

clauses.name: Pluff
clauses.printedParagraph: When Pluff enters the field, discard a card from the top of your deck.

limits: Fifteen selected fixed-quantity clauses, not all abilities or interactions of the thirteen cards.

Trigger stimuli are explicit and use production queues. Five additional producer cases use actual Support/Will/deck-discard paths; tribute-producing declarations and complete matches are not certified.
Ponder and Zum use real declarations, exact paid essences and resolution. Other Zum abilities and the all-five Support condition are outside this batch.
Pidue covers only its vitreous draw and melancholic discard branches. Its other temperaments remain outside this batch.
Kanon replacement checks use Manifestations as discarded cards, so the Will-discard power-distribution follow-up is not certified by this batch.

BOB/Quasimillenary ordering is tested on simple single hand-discard effects. Discard-then-draw conditional continuations, exiling costs, shuffles and larger sequential effects require separate proofs.
The network journeys use controlled event/replacement fixtures and actual choice/priority messages; auto-phase driving is isolated.
No new card UI, physical-device, Safari or illustration certification is implied.
